def test_product_reference_requires_stable_reference_id():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_product_reference(ProductReference(kind=ProductReferenceKind.PRODUCTO_CANONICO, reference_id=""))
    validate_product_reference(ProductReference(kind=ProductReferenceKind.CATALOGO_EXTENDIDO, reference_id="EXT-1"))


def test_membership_owned_bottle_requires_assignment_and_membership():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_custody_context(BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.MEMBERSHIP, owner_membership_id="MEM-1"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_custody_context(BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="ASG-1", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.MEMBERSHIP))
    validate_custody_context(BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="ASG-1", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.MEMBERSHIP, owner_membership_id="MEM-1"))


def test_shared_assignment_bottle_does_not_fake_individual_owner():
    validate_custody_context(BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="ASG-1", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.ASSIGNMENT_SHARED))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_custody_context(BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="ASG-1", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.ASSIGNMENT_SHARED, owner_membership_id="MEM-1"))


def test_individual_bottle_identity_is_not_socio_id_based():
    identity = IndividualBottleIdentity(
        bottle_id="BOT-1",
        product=ProductReference(kind=ProductReferenceKind.PRODUCTO_CANONICO, reference_id="PROD-1", presentation_reference_id="PRES-750"),
        custody=BottleCustodyContext(assignment_id="ASG-1", ownership_kind=BottleOwnershipKind.MEMBERSHIP, owner_membership_id="MEM-1", current_physical_cava_id="CAVA-1"),
    )
    validate_individual_bottle_identity(identity)
    assert not hasattr(identity.custody, "socio_id")
